summary: B1 isolated CI evidence, read-only Host premerge checks and local flock; independent Reviewer REVISE on prior f976ad56 P0=1/P1=2 was addressed by workflow provenance pinning, expanded trusted blobs and public-key snapshot verification. New exact-SHA review pending.

components.owning_subsystem: GitHub Actions CI evidence job, separate read-only Host GitHub API verifier and narrow local integration-writer flock
components.disposition: ADMIT isolated B1 code and negative tests only. Host never merges or pushes; no production activation, no branch protection changes and no automatic remote main CAS.
evidence: B1-1 CI evidence job and initial tests were developed in LFL Web with glm/glm-5.3-flash; B1-2 Host/lock code and negative tests were authored by the main developer.

Independent DeepSeek-v4-Flash Reviewer of f976ad56f01bc4b76c5ad0c5c80eff4dc0787ba7 returned REVISE P0=1/P1=2: default check-runs latest and unpinned run.workflow_id/path; three-blob trust set omitted scanner/installer/project; HMAC same-domain self-signing. None of this review is a PASS for the new candidate.

The revised Host requires check-runs filter=all, exact context/app_id, run workflow_id/path from approved policy, tested merge check runs and parent SHAs, remote main/PR final recheck, branch protection, Actions artifact, and main/candidate equality for twelve trusted gate/dependency blobs (including Host verifier and integration lock).

Host snapshot verification uses only a public Ed25519 key; the signing private key and authoritative Lane/Queue/Reviewer/R9 issuer must remain outside the verifier and are not yet wired into production.
Local integration tool uses OS flock under real git-common-dir, rejects concurrent writers, refuses main and dirty trees and preserves conflicts; no remote ref CAS is claimed.

Remote GitHub main protection API returned 404 Branch not protected; approved required-ci-checks.json absent at main. Host eligibility is BLOCKED until separately authorized bootstrap and protected policy installation.
components.verification_level: Focused B1 CI/Host/flock tests and static/A.5 checks rerun on revised candidate; prior independent Reviewer REVISE P0=1/P1=2, new independent code Reviewer and original full R9 still pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Any 403/404, absent trusted policy/public key, invalid Ed25519 snapshot signature, stale Lane/Queue version, failed reviewer/R9, wrong run.workflow_id/path, duplicate context, skipped/RED check, untrusted gate dependency blob, or lock contention must HOLD without merge side effect.
components.rollback_route: Revert isolated B1 PR or disable the CI evidence job; no durable migration or production changes. Dirty integration worktrees are retained for owner reconciliation.

components.disposition: Document exact changed paths and truthful verification status without adding runtime authority.
evidence: A.5 declaration includes itself and exactly seven B1 implementation/test/workflow paths.
components.verification_level: A.5 exact changed-path coverage must pass on final SHA; independent Reviewer, original full R9 and remote CI are pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: If coverage or declaration is inaccurate, correct in the isolated branch and re-run A.5; never claim unperformed review/R9/CI as complete.
components.rollback_route: Revert the isolated PR; no runtime state impact.

g1.necessity: B1 needs a machine-consumed CI sibling evidence job, independent Host verification of required GitHub rules/check runs and trusted gate blobs, and a single local integration writer to avoid two simultaneous cherry-picks.

g2.authority_owner: GitHub API owns branch rules/check runs and Actions evidence; existing LFL Lane/Queue/Reviewer/R9 stores remain authoritative. A separately trusted Host snapshot issuer holds the Ed25519 signing private key; this verifier has only the public key. Git common dir OS flock serializes the narrow local integration tool.
g2.non_duplication: Reuse existing CI and four siblings; no new Goal/Lane ledger, no generic shell executor, no remote atomic CAS. Host Ed25519 snapshot issuer is NOT yet wired into production, so this isolated candidate does not qualify for live merge.

model_evidence: Independent DeepSeek-v4-Flash Reviewer of prior f976ad56 returned REVISE P0=1/P1=2, with specific same-name fake workflow, scanner self-bypass and same-key snapshot attacks; code and negative tests were revised, not yet re-reviewed.

Synthetic tests cover duplicate check-run names, wrong workflow_id/path, twelve main/candidate trusted blobs, independent Ed25519 public-key verification, branch protection absence, main advance, PR run provenance and two-process flock.
No live Host eligibility PASS is claimed: remote main protection 404, trusted policy and independent snapshot issuer not installed.
g3.recovery_or_reason: If required context provenance is ambiguous or gate/policy blob differs from protected main, return HOLD; require separate bootstrap. Reject self-signed snapshot or missing public key. Preserve dirty integration tree for operator reconciliation.

g4.rollback: Revert isolated B1 PR to remove CI/Host/local integration tool; no persistent data schema changes or live deployment.
verification: Rerun focused tests, Ruff, A.5 exact path coverage on final SHA; independent Reviewer must PASS P0/P1=0 after the P0/P1 fixes.
Run original complete R9 exit 0 and remote PR CI for the final SHA before any protected main integration.
Separately authorize and verify required context bootstrap, branch protection, trusted policy and independent snapshot issuer; do not treat this candidate as self-authorized.
